brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing added beside or on top
requirements.evidence: Build has one cell at 0,0,0 with piece:0,0,0;half-n only. No neighboring pieces. Caps are edge finish, not cells.

Only one drawer can be placed: drawer:0#0,0#cut (south half). Configurator offers 1 drawer socket per half-n (s) and reports 'No place' after one is filled; HOST_MISMATCH prevents additional drawers in same cell. System enforces 1 drawer max per half base, so 5 drawers is not achievable under configurator rules.

finish.summary: Single half-n base (the only base type that accepts a drawer) with 1 drawer installed; 4 additional drawers refused by configurator (HOST_MISMATCH / no sockets). Build verified: check_build ok, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
